items.definition:
a person who produces videos for YouTube
She dreams of becoming a famous YouTuber.

a rotating machine or device, especially one for conveying luggage at an airport or a merry-go-round
We waited by the baggage carousel for our suitcases.

a very small breed of dog with large ears
My aunt has a tiny chihuahua that barks a lot.

a collection of things lying about in an untidy mass
Her desk was covered in clutter, making it hard to find anything.

decayed organic material used as a fertilizer
We add our kitchen scraps to the compost bin.

a disadvantage or problem
The main drawback of this plan is its high cost.

a children's story about magical and imaginary beings and lands
My grandmother used to read me a fairytale every night before bed.

an expert in geology; a person who studies the Earth's physical structure and substance
The geologist examined the rock samples to determine their age.

a pair of linked metal rings for securing a prisoner's wrists
The police officer put the suspect in handcuffs.

a person who rides a horse
The horseman rode swiftly across the plains.

a light ringing sound; a short, catchy tune
I heard the jingle of keys in his pocket.

a person or company that moves furniture or belongings; a person who initiates or promotes something
We hired a professional mover to help us relocate.

a person who arranges or plans an event; a device for keeping things tidy
She was the main organiser of the conference.

freelance photographers who pursue celebrities
The paparazzi followed the movie star everywhere.

a small house for children to play in, or a theater
The children spent hours playing in their new playhouse.

a large farming implement with one or more blades fixed in a frame, used to turn over soil
The farmer used a plow to prepare the field for planting.

the time at which a radio or television audience is expected to be at its largest
The show airs during primetime on Tuesdays.

a flammable hydrocarbon gas, used as fuel
We use propane to fuel our outdoor grill.

a large board for displaying the score of a game or match
The fans cheered as the score changed on the scoreboard.

a person who skis
The skier glided gracefully down the slope.

a word or phrase that means exactly or nearly the same as another
"Big" is a synonym for "large."

a brief break in play or activity
The coach called a timeout to discuss strategy.

a pace of a horse faster than a walk
The horse broke into a steady trot.

wooden parts of a building or room
The old house had beautiful original woodwork.

the rear part of something or someone
The house has a lovely garden on the backside.

a person who plays the bass guitar or double bass
The band's new bassist is very talented.

a power-driven saw with a toothed chain
He used a chainsaw to cut down the old tree.

a longer or roundabout way
We had to take a detour because of road construction.

the action or state of making or becoming larger
The enlargement of the photograph revealed more details.

a container, typically made of metal or glass, used for holding liquids
He carried a hot drink in his thermos flask.

soft, light material, such as down or cotton
There was a lot of dust and fluff under the bed.

a person who gives something
She is a generous giver to charity.

A large, luxurious car, especially one driven by a chauffeur.
They arrived at the event in a long black limousine.

Animal dung used for fertilizing land.
Farmers spread manure on the fields to enrich the soil.

a horizontal support on a ladder
He climbed to the top rung of the ladder.

a very tall building
New York City is famous for its impressive skyscrapers.

a long, flexible arm-like limb
The octopus used its tentacles to grab the crab.

a tool or implement, especially for cooking or eating
Please put the cooking utensils in the drawer.

a person who admires someone or something
She has many secret admirers.

a seat in the back of a car.
The children sat in the backseat of the car.

a large, decorative hanging light with branches for several bulbs or candles.
A beautiful crystal chandelier hung in the dining room.

An alphabetical list of terms with definitions, typically found at the end of a book.
Check the glossary at the back of the book for the meaning of unfamiliar words.

A large room or building for indoor sports and physical exercise.
The school gymnasium is used for basketball and volleyball.

A person doing unskilled manual work for wages.
The labourer spent all day digging trenches.

A small boat carried by a ship for use in an emergency, or a boat used for rescuing people at sea.
The crew lowered the lifeboat as the ship began to sink.

a lottery in which prizes are won by drawing tickets
They organized a raffle to raise money for the charity.

the act or process of writing songs
Her passion for songwriting began at a young age.

a person who runs in a sprint
The sprinter trained hard for the upcoming race.

an animal doctor
We took our dog to the veterinarian for its annual check-up.

a person who enjoys or seeks adventure
He was a true adventurer, always seeking new challenges.

a large, non-venomous snake; a long, thin scarf of feathers or fur
The boa constrictor can grow to be very long.

A soft, woven fabric
He wore a warm flannel shirt.

a square of cloth used for wiping the nose or face
He pulled a clean handkerchief from his pocket.

a small, secluded corner or recess
She found a cozy reading nook by the window.

material used to pad or stuff something
The package was filled with soft padding to protect the fragile items.

a Brazilian dance of African origin
The carnival parade was filled with vibrant samba dancers.

a hit in cricket that scores six runs; a pack of six items
He hit a sixer over the boundary.

a small water bottle; a place where food is served in a factory, school, or camp
He filled his canteen with water before the hike.

a person or machine that digs
The construction site was full of diggers and other heavy machinery.

a dark red gemstone
She wore a necklace with a beautiful garnet pendant.

a planned informal meeting
Let's arrange a meetup next week to discuss the project.

a hard, granular cheese
She grated some Parmesan cheese over her pasta.

a large water bird with a pouch under its beak
A pelican was gracefully fishing in the shallow waters.

a person who receives a pension, especially an old-age pension
Many pensioners rely on public transport discounts.
